mongoForm.adv.extraHint: Only these options are accepted, each within a safe range.
mongoForm.adv.queryLimitHint: The server stops every query after this many seconds (1 to 60).
mongoForm.ai.cap: Needs Node ({node}) and the Claude CLI ({cli}).
mongoForm.ai.denyHint: These names are removed before anything is sent. Removing one needs the connection name.
mongoForm.ai.glossaryHint: Words your team uses and the field or value they mean (up to 50 pairs).
mongoForm.ai.modeHint: The AI drafts a query from a question. You review it and nothing runs until you press Run.
mongoForm.ai.p0.body: Nothing is sent to a model.
mongoForm.ai.p0.title: P0 · AI off
mongoForm.ai.p1.body: The question and the field names, types and indexes. No documents, no values.
mongoForm.ai.p1.title: P1 · Schema only
mongoForm.ai.p1plus.body: As P1, plus distinct values of short, low-cardinality fields. Never at the production level.
mongoForm.ai.p1plus.title: P1+ · Schema and value lists
mongoForm.ai.presetHint: The wording, examples and tenant field names the AI starts from.
mongoForm.ai.productionNote: Production-level connections stay at P1: no samples, ever.
mongoForm.allowed.added: {count, plural, one {Host added} other {# hosts added}}. Save to keep it.
mongoForm.allowed.hint: The tunnel may open connections only to these host:port pairs.
mongoForm.allowed.label: Allowed database hosts
mongoForm.allowed.srv: For SRV addresses every host under the cluster's domain is allowed automatically.
mongoForm.auth.draftStale: The pasted password was for another destination and is not used. Type it again.
mongoForm.auth.dropSaved: The destination changed, so this connection's saved secrets are removed when you save. Type them again.
mongoForm.auth.plainWarn: PLAIN needs TLS. A connection without TLS to a remote host is refused.
mongoForm.auth.x509Needs: Choose a client certificate file on the TLS tab.
mongoForm.auth.x509User: The certificate subject, for example CN=me,OU=team. Leave empty to use the one in the certificate.
mongoForm.color.label: Colour
mongoForm.confirm.aria: Type the connection name to confirm
mongoForm.confirm.body: Type the connection name {name} to continue.
mongoForm.confirm.reason.ai: AI is turned on or raised.
mongoForm.confirm.reason.deny: A field is removed from the AI deny list.
mongoForm.confirm.title: Confirmation needed.
mongoForm.database.hint: Optional. It is also the default authentication database.
mongoForm.database.label: Default database
mongoForm.description: Read-only: the studio cannot change data. Passwords are kept only in the Keychain.
mongoForm.direct.label: Connect directly to one server
mongoForm.env.label: Tag
mongoForm.extra.heartbeatFrequencyMS: How often servers are checked, in milliseconds.
mongoForm.extra.loadBalanced: Set to true behind a load balancer.
mongoForm.extra.localThresholdMS: Latency window for choosing among servers, in milliseconds.
mongoForm.extra.maxIdleTimeMS: Close idle connections after this many milliseconds.
mongoForm.extra.srvMaxHosts: Maximum hosts taken from an SRV record, 0 to 16.
mongoForm.extra.srvServiceName: Service name for the SRV lookup.
mongoForm.group.label: Group
mongoForm.hostKey.forgotten: Forgot the saved host key of {host}
mongoForm.hosts.label: Hosts
mongoForm.hosts.srvHint: An SRV address is one DNS name without a port. The members are looked up on this computer.
mongoForm.legacy.body: This connection ({host}) was saved as one string by an older version. Convert it to fields to edit the details. Nothing changes until you save.
mongoForm.legacy.dropped: {count, plural, one {# option} other {# options}} will be ignored or removed. See Advanced.
mongoForm.legacy.title: Saved as a connection string
mongoForm.mechHint.default: The server and the driver agree on SCRAM-SHA-256 or SCRAM-SHA-1.
mongoForm.mechHint.none: Connect without signing in. Only for a local test server.
mongoForm.mechHint.plain: Sends the password in clear text inside the connection; use it only with TLS.
mongoForm.mechHint.x509: The client certificate is the identity. Set it on the TLS tab.
mongoForm.mode.label: Input mode
mongoForm.name.label: Name
mongoForm.note.authMechanism: uses a sign-in method that is not supported.
mongoForm.note.duplicate: was given twice; the last value is used.
mongoForm.note.ignoredReadOnly: is ignored: this studio only reads.
mongoForm.note.placeholderPassword: is an Atlas placeholder; type your password.
mongoForm.note.placeholderUsername: is an Atlas placeholder; type your user name.
mongoForm.note.proxy: is set on the Tunnel tab instead.
mongoForm.note.relativePath: is a relative or ~ path; use an absolute path.
mongoForm.note.tlsRelaxRequested: asks to skip certificate checks. Turn it on under TLS if you really want it.
mongoForm.note.unsupportedInBuild: cannot be honoured by this build; the host name is always checked.
mongoForm.problem.allowed.invalid: Not an allowed destination (link-local and metadata addresses are never allowed).
mongoForm.problem.appName.invalid: Letters, digits, space, dot, dash and underscore, up to 64.
mongoForm.problem.config.plainRemote: A password or PLAIN over a connection without TLS to a remote host is refused. Turn TLS on.
mongoForm.problem.database.invalid: A database name cannot contain spaces or the characters / \ . " $
mongoForm.problem.replicaSet.invalid: Letters, digits, space, dot, dash and underscore, up to 64.
mongoForm.problem.select.noReplicaSet: A secondary read preference needs a replica set; reads may find no server.
mongoForm.problem.srv.noDirect: SRV cannot connect directly to one server.
mongoForm.problem.srv.noPort: An SRV address has no port.
mongoForm.problem.srv.oneHost: An SRV address has exactly one host.
mongoForm.problem.ssh.keyFileAuth: A key file needs the Key file sign-in.
mongoForm.problem.x509.needsCert: X.509 needs a client certificate file (TLS tab).
mongoForm.proxy.note: Your own proxy, for example ssh -D 1080 bastion. The database host name is sent to the proxy.
mongoForm.proxy.plainWarn: A proxy password is sent in clear text. Use a loopback proxy or turn TLS on.
mongoForm.readPref.hint: Automatic reads from the primary locally and prefers a secondary at the production level.
mongoForm.readPref.label: Read preference
mongoForm.replicaSet.label: Replica set name
mongoForm.safety.overrideHint: Type the host {host} to lower the level. This also needs the connection name below.
mongoForm.safety.overrideOn: The level is lowered for this connection.
mongoForm.safety.readOnlyHint: Always on. The studio has no command that changes data.
mongoForm.safety.snippetBody: Create it once in mongosh. The command contains no password; mongosh asks for it.
mongoForm.safety.tenantHint: A field name. Every query must then filter on it, so one tenant cannot read another tenant's rows.
mongoForm.safety.why.loopback: All hosts are on this computer.
mongoForm.safety.why.remoteHost: {host} is not on this computer, so the connection is production-level.
mongoForm.safety.why.tunnel: Every tunnel counts as production-level: the database host as the bastion sees it says nothing about this computer.
mongoForm.safety.whyType: To treat it as non-production, type {host} below.
mongoForm.save.confirm: This lowers a safety setting. Type the connection name to confirm.
mongoForm.save.needSecret: A secret is missing for this destination.
mongoForm.save.relaxRefused: Skipping certificate checks is not allowed at this level.
mongoForm.scheme.label: Connection type
mongoForm.secret.askEachTime: Not saved: the IDE asks every time you connect.
mongoForm.secret.sessionOnly: No Keychain here: secrets last until you quit the IDE.
mongoForm.secret.unavailable: The secret store is not available: secrets cannot be saved.
mongoForm.staleness.label: Maximum staleness
mongoForm.summary.title: {count, plural, one {# problem to fix} other {# problems to fix}}
mongoForm.tabs.label: Connection settings
mongoForm.test.busy: Another test is running. Try again in a moment.
mongoForm.test.needSecret: A password is needed for this destination. Type it and test again.
mongoForm.test.needsReview: This connection was changed outside the IDE. Save it again to review it.
mongoForm.test.title: Connection test
mongoForm.tls.caHint: Leave empty to use the built-in roots. Needed for a company or private CA.
mongoForm.tls.clientHint: One PEM file with the certificate and the private key.
mongoForm.tls.mode.hint: Automatic turns TLS on for SRV and Atlas addresses.
mongoForm.tls.mode.label: TLS
mongoForm.tls.pemOnly: Only PEM files are supported. Convert a .p12 file with openssl first.
mongoForm.tls.relax.noHostname: There is no option to skip only the host name check.
mongoForm.tls.relax.refused: Not available at the production level. Use a CA file or a tunnel instead.
mongoForm.tls.relax.title: Relax checks
mongoForm.tls.relax.warn: Anyone on the network path could impersonate the server and read the credentials. Use it only for a throw-away local test.
mongoForm.tunnel.auth.label: Sign-in
mongoForm.tunnel.hostHint: A name or an alias from ~/.ssh/config.
mongoForm.tunnel.keyFileHint: Path to the private key. Only ssh reads it, never this app.
mongoForm.tunnel.noJump: Another hop? Put ProxyJump in ~/.ssh/config. The host key check covers only this first host.
mongoForm.tunnel.production: A tunnel makes the connection production-level, whatever the host names say.
mongoForm.tunnel.srvNote: SRV and TXT name lookups happen on this computer, outside the tunnel.
mongoForm.tunnel.unavailable: SSH tunnels are not available on this system.
mongoForm.uri.badScheme: A MongoDB connection string starts with mongodb:// or mongodb+srv://.
mongoForm.uri.hint: Paste the string; it fills the fields. The password goes straight to a protected store and the text is cleared.
mongoForm.uri.infoNotes: {count, plural, one {# read-only option ignored} other {# read-only options ignored}}
mongoForm.uri.label: Connection string
mongoForm.uri.notes: {count, plural, one {# option needs attention} other {# options need attention}}
